tool.title: Escore ISTH de CID manifesta
tool.desc: Escore da ISTH para coagulação intravascular disseminada (CID) manifesta: plaquetas, D-dímero, tempo de protrombina e fibrinogênio; 5 ou mais é compatível.
tool.lead: Diagnostica a coagulação intravascular disseminada manifesta com exames simples, em pacientes com doença de base que sabidamente causa CID.
tool.formula:
Plaquetas > 100 mil 0, 50–100 mil 1, < 50 mil 2 · D-dímero/PDF sem aumento 0, moderado 2, acentuado 3 · TP prolongado < 3 s 0, 3–6 s 1, > 6 s 2 · fibrinogênio ≥ 1 g/L 0, < 1 g/L 1. Máximo: 8.

Pré-requisito: doença de base associada a CID (sepse, trauma, câncer, complicação obstétrica etc.).
sources: Taylor FB Jr et al. Towards definition, clinical and laboratory criteria, and a scoring system for disseminated intravascular coagulation. Thromb Haemost, 2001.
Levi M et al. Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of disseminated intravascular coagulation. Br J Haematol, 2009.

Larsen JB et al. Disseminated intravascular coagulation diagnosis: Positive predictive value of the ISTH score in a Danish population. Research and Practice in Thrombosis and Haemostasis, 2021. Table 1 (fibrinogen boundary).
cases: Plaquetas 80 mil, D-dímero moderado, TP +2 s, fibrinogênio normal: 3 pontos
Corte: plaquetas 40 mil, D-dímero moderado, TP +4 s: 5 pontos

pointContract.categoricalWeightScope: Selected point codes only; exact100platelet,3/6second and1g/L boundary inclusivity is not established by this2001 printed table. Current form uses50–100,3–6 and>=1g/L; later support for some boundaries is distinct source evidence, not full2001 conformity.
pointContract.later2025: Table1 explicitly uses>=50,<100 for platelet1 and>=3,<6 for PT1,>=6 for PT2; section4 proposes D-dimer>3×ULN for2 and>7×ULN for3. Do not silently substitute2025 or infer universal assay thresholds.

sources.scope: All54 combinations of four already selected source point-code domains, exact integer score only. No raw laboratory boundary classification, diagnosis threshold, clinical prerequisite gate, nonovert/SIC variant or dynamic course is validated.
sources.limitations: OriginalTable2 has ambiguous equalities and overlapping platelet shorthand. Moderate/strong fibrin increase requires assay-specific definitions in the original text. Underlying disease compatible with overtDIC is a prerequisite, not a numeric score component.2025revision and2021INR/localD-dimer study are distinct; numerical summation does not approve any diagnoses, interpretation or treatment.

independentPeer.scope: Independently read selected primary tables, own frozen source-point expectations and three adapters Node/isolatedChromium. Source scope partial; local MESS72 zero cases separated; no clinical/rights/full-method approval.

independentArithmeticTest.actualBrowserEvidenceScope: Original isolated actual Chromium, each of the three exactly bound adapters, source-only rows. Separate local MESS72 extension is not part of this source bank.
qualifications: OriginalTable2 has ambiguous equalities and overlapping platelet shorthand. Moderate/strong fibrin increase requires assay-specific definitions in the original text. Underlying disease compatible with overtDIC is a prerequisite, not a numeric score component.2025revision and2021INR/localD-dimer study are distinct; numerical summation does not approve any diagnoses, interpretation or treatment.
MESS source bank excludes all72 local zero-ischemia examples. Those remain in the untouched original platform-extension receipt and are not counted as source conformity.

Only raw.score selected-point arithmetic is included. Clinical categories, main text, private level/verdict/note/rows, prognosis, diagnosis, management and unmeasured feature classification are excluded.

All source scenarios in this bank and the original donor reports remain retained. Mirror/runtime calculations do not multiply scenario counts. Inline four examples are a subset of the complete downloadable bank.

Source fields, rubric/edition labels, clinical scope notes and localization changes have separate ownership and must be composed without replacing whole catalogs. All862 historic fixtures/tolerances and approval flags remain unchanged.
Fresh source/build/packages and browser journey bindings are required before publication. No already-served website or final package proof is claimed by this preparation.
